body_markdown:
In a recent episode of *[Profiles in Risk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JEsemYSDYLQ)* (part of the Insurance Nerds podcast network) host Tony Cañas sat down with Amir Prodensky, CEO and co-founder of Strada, to talk about something we’re all trying to figure out right now: what does AI really *do* for insurance?


If you’re in the industry and feel like every other email or podcast is about AI, you’re not alone. But what makes Strada different (and why this conversation stood out) is that it’s *actually* practical.


Strada solves a real problem: how to make phone calls between insurance companies, insurance agents, and policyholders smarter, faster, and more scalable, without throwing people under the bus.


Let’s dive into what Amir shared, what makes Strada unique, and what this all means for insurance professionals.
